synopsis: A few weeks after Silvermoon’s formal admission to the Horde, domestic unrest is contained beneath proclamations, arrests, wary mana lines, and the practical need to answer the first orders from the broader faction. Falanaras, Theron, and Lethira march with a small sin’dorei detachment representing Silvermoon’s uneasy strengths—Blood Knights, rangers, magisters, rogues from Murder Row, and a warlock—under orc command to reinforce Horde-held Tarren Mill against constant Alliance pressure from Southshore. Gorath Stonebinder, the orc shaman who tested Falanaras during the admission council, commands the mixed Horde force alongside Jazreth Shadowtide, a Darkspear shadow priest; Mavren Coldwake, a Forsaken warrior; and Tahu Windtotem, a tauren druid. The duel left Gorath with wary respect for Falanaras’s discipline, though suspicion of blood elf power persists among the soldiers under his command. They arrive with fighting underway and enter a chaotic defense beside allies who distrust them. Alliance paladins recoil from the Blood Knights’ crimson-tinted radiance as horrific sacrilege, unaware of M’uru’s identity but recognizing that the Light has been forced into something wrong. In the battle’s heart, Edric Hale faces Falanaras as a former friend turned bitter enemy. Their duel of sacred gold against stolen red-gold clears the field around them because no one else wants to enter that blinding collision. Falanaras defeats Edric but spares him; afterward he glimpses Caelir Dawnspear among the Alliance, watching with grief and shame. Falanaras sheds first blood for the Horde and proves that he can choose restraint, but sparing Edric cannot restore their old bonds or make his new belonging simple.
title: Chapter 18: Hillsbrad, First Blood for the Horde
